## FILTERING DECONTX OBJECT TO REMOVE POTENTIAL DOUBLETS

### MAYBE DONT DO THIS LOL

```{r}
sample_files <- list.files(
  path = here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "sample_results"),
  pattern = "_object_with_decontX\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

sample_files

newTotalCells <- 0

for (inFile in sample_files) {
  
  base_name <- basename(inFile)
  sID <- str_remove(base_name, "_object_with_decontX\\.(rds|Rdata)$")
  
  print(paste0("Load sample: ", sID))
  
  sObj <- readRDS(inFile) 
  
  maxContam <- 0.6
  
  newObj <- subset(sObj, subset = decontX_contamination < maxContam)
  
  out_dir <- dirname(inFile)
  
  f_seurat_rds <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(sID, "_object_with_decontX_FILTERED.rds"))
  
  saveRDS(newObj, f_seurat_rds)
  
  print(paste0("Num Cells Before Filter: ", ncol(sObj)))

  print(paste0("Num Cells After Filter: ", ncol(newObj)))
  
  newTotalCells <- newTotalCells + ncol(newObj)
  
  print(paste0("Finished sample: ", sID))
}

```
